notes: The text opens «قال أبو حازم» and writes no chain before him: an implicit transmission (rule 11)
«هكذا سمعت سهلا» is Nu'man's remark inside the scene, not a link; «أشهد على أبي سعيد الخدري لسمعته» gives Abu Sa'id as the Companion heard

fixes.reason: HKG's route names Nu'man b. Zayd b. al-Samit and Salama b. Dinar, but the text names a different Nu'man (Ibn Abi Ayyash) as a bystander and writes no Salama link
